mapper.sql: endpoint_id, tenant_id, url, event_types, status, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_webhook_endpoint WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY create_time, endpoint_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_webhook_endpoint SET url = #{url}, event_types = #{eventTypes}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE endpoint_id = #{item.endpointId} AND version = #{item.version}
UPDATE t_webhook_endpoint SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE endpoint_id = #{item.endpointId} AND version = #{item.version} AND status = #{item.status}
